thought.text: While the cargo tools compile, let me run `pnpm install` in the background (it's independent of the Rust tooling).

reasoning_content:
OK. The migrate binary is in the server crate. So now let's check the progress and wait. The cargo install will probably take a few minutes. In the meantime, let's run `pnpm install` for the frontend. It doesn't depend on the cargo tools (it does depend on the wasm-pack build, but pnpm install itself doesn't depend on it). In fact, `just setup` runs `pnpm install`, and then builds the workspace packages. Let's run pnpm install in the background now to save time.

No, wait. `just setup` depends on `build-domain-wasm`, which requires wasm-pack. So we have to wait for wasm-pack. But pnpm install can be run independently.

Let's run pnpm install in the background right now.

While the cargo tool is building, let's kick off pnpm install in the background now to save time.

action.command: cd /workspace/frontend && (nohup bash -c 'pnpm install 2>&1; echo "PNPM_EXIT:$?"' > /tmp/pnpm-install.log 2>&1 &) && echo "pnpm install started"

tool_call.name: terminal
